entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Starting check"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Начата проверка"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Prefetched $($descriptorLookup.Count) security descriptor(s) in one query"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Дескрипторов безопасности, полученных одним запросом: $($descriptorLookup.Count)"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Descriptor prefetch failed, falling back to one read per GPO: $_" -Level Warning
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Не удалось предварительно получить дескрипторы — переход к отдельному чтению каждой GPO: $_" -Level Warning

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Analyzing GPO: $gpoDisplayName ($gpoGUID)"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Анализ GPO: $gpoDisplayName ($gpoGUID)"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Security descriptor of GPO '$gpoDisplayName' could not be read or parsed - its permissions are unknown" -Level Warning
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Дескриптор безопасности GPO '$gpoDisplayName' нельзя прочитать или разобрать — права неизвестны" -Level Warning

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] GPO '$gpoDisplayName' is owned by $($ownerFinding.Owner), which is not a default owner"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Владелец GPO '$gpoDisplayName' — $($ownerFinding.Owner), это не владелец по умолчанию"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] No dangerous ACEs found for GPO: $gpoDisplayName"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Опасных ACE для GPO не найдено: $gpoDisplayName"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Processing $($dangerousAces.Count) dangerous ACE(s) for GPO: $gpoDisplayName"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Обработка $($dangerousAces.Count) опасных ACE для GPO: $gpoDisplayName"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Skipping ACE with empty SID on GPO $gpoDisplayName (ACE object type: $($ace.GetType().FullName))"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Пропуск ACE с пустым SID в GPO $gpoDisplayName (тип объекта ACE: $($ace.GetType().FullName))"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Skipping descendants-only ACE on GPO $gpoDisplayName : $($ace.Trustee), PropagationFlags=$($ace.PropagationFlags)"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Пропуск ACE только для потомков в GPO $gpoDisplayName : $($ace.Trustee), PropagationFlags=$($ace.PropagationFlags)"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] $aceSID holds $dangerousRight on GPO $gpoDisplayName but a Deny ACE takes it away"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Субъект $aceSID имеет право $dangerousRight в GPO $gpoDisplayName, но оно отменено запрещающим ACE"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] $($ace.Trustee) holds $aceRights on GPO $gpoDisplayName scoped to the class $($resolvedScope.Name) - no right over the policy"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Субъект $($ace.Trustee) имеет права $aceRights в GPO $gpoDisplayName для класса $($resolvedScope.Name) — прав на саму политику нет"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Skipping expected identity $aceSID on GPO $gpoDisplayName : $($expectedCheck.Reason)"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Пропущен ожидаемый субъект $aceSID в GPO $gpoDisplayName : $($expectedCheck.Reason)"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Expected identity $aceSID has $aceRights on GPO $gpoDisplayName - $($scopeResult.Reason)"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Ожидаемый субъект $aceSID имеет права $aceRights в GPO $gpoDisplayName — $($scopeResult.Reason)"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Attention: $identityName has $aceRights on GPO $gpoDisplayName - $($scopeResult.Reason) - skipped (use -IncludePrivileged to include)"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Требует внимания: $identityName имеет права $aceRights в GPO $gpoDisplayName — $($scopeResult.Reason); пропущен (для включения укажите -IncludePrivileged)"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] IncludePrivileged: Including $identityName ($aceSID) with severity $severity on GPO $gpoDisplayName"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] IncludePrivileged: субъект $identityName ($aceSID) включён с критичностью $severity в GPO $gpoDisplayName"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] FINDING: $identityName has $dangerousRightMatched on GPO $gpoDisplayName (inherited: $([bool]$ace.IsInherited))"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] НАХОДКА: субъект $identityName обладает опасным правом $dangerousRightMatched в GPO $gpoDisplayName (унаследовано: $([bool]$ace.IsInherited))"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Error analyzing GPO $gpoDisplayName : $_"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Ошибка анализа GPO $gpoDisplayName : $_"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] SYSVOL is not reachable at $policiesPath - the folder permissions were not examined"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] SYSVOL по пути $policiesPath недоступен — разрешения на папки не проверялись"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Could not list $policiesPath - missing and orphaned policy folders are not told apart: $($folderListErrors[0])"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Невозможно перечислить $policiesPath — нельзя отличить отсутствующие папки политик от осиротевших: $($folderListErrors[0])"

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Error: $_" -Level Error
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Ошибка: $_" -Level Error

entries.original: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Check completed"
entries.target: Write-Log "[Get-GPOPermissions] Проверка завершена"
